questions.question: The 900,001 saturation is coupled to the cap setting's maximum (20,000-900,000), not to any model's context window (~1M on the deployed model). So a real mark can exceed it, and if the cap range is ever widened above 900,000 a clipped mark silently stops exceeding the cap — retirement quietly stops firing. The only genuine problem was the Postgres integer overflow above 2,147,483,647. How should the clamp be defined?
